notice: Market data notice: bars are delayed 15+ minutes depending on the exchange — the last bar is not a live price and may still change; no pre/post-market bars; prices are split-adjusted only; some exchanges are served from an alternative or end-of-day feed. For the most recent quote use get_symbol_data (or get_symbol_data_batch) with the "close", "change" and "update_mode" columns.

summary.volume_unit_note: avg_volume / total_volume / last_bar_volume are in BASE units (shares for equities, base tokens for crypto). Do NOT prepend $ to these. last_bar_notional_estimate is approximately the dollar volume of the LAST bar (close × volume), valid only for USD-equivalent quote currencies (USDT/USDC/USD/USX equities).
